thread:
customer_jane: Hey support — noticed duplicate charge on our March invoice. Invoice inv_778a shows the same session token usage (~1.6M tokens) twice. Request IDs we have: req-04f2a, req-04f2b. This happened after our frontend retried once due to a 504. We only expect one charge, can you investigate?

maria_support: Sorry for the trouble. Can you paste the raw request headers + approximate timestamps? If you have an Idempotency-Key that would help. I'll escalate to infra + billing.

customer_jane: Here's the curl we used (we didn't set Idempotency-Key):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-XXX"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"prompt":"<...>","max_tokens":1600120}'

We retry on network 504 after 1s, just re-send. Timestamps ~ 2026-03-04T14:18:05Z.

billing_bot: invoice_event: created invoice inv_778a id=inv_778a amount=... ledger_tx: lt_9932 created (automated)

engops_tim: grabbing gateway logs now. Are req-04f2a/b client-side ids or gateway ids? I can already see two deliveries for a very similar payload ~1s apart. Gateway returned 504 to client on the first attempt but backend accepted both deliveries. Looks like no idempotency key => replays accepted.

sre_alan: logs snippet: 

[2026-03-04T14:18:05.123Z] gw: req=gw-7f9c path=/v1/generate status=504 client_id=acct-234
[2026-03-04T14:18:05.124Z] backend: req=gw-7f9c -> model-pp status=200 tokens=1600120 ledger_id=lt_9932
[2026-03-04T14:18:06.130Z] gw: req=gw-7f9d path=/v1/generate status=200 client_id=acct-234
[2026-03-04T14:18:06.131Z] backend: req=gw-7f9d -> model-pp status=200 tokens=1600120 ledger_id=lt_9933

So two ledger entries created for the same logical operation.

maria_support: That explains the duplicate line items. We'll open a reconciliation and credit one of the ledger transactions. @billing_team please confirm policy for retro credits when duplicates are caused by gateway retries. Recommend credit the later ledger_id (lt_9933).

billing_bot: billing policy: credits approved for confirmed duplicate metering events. Marked inv_778a as under review; pending manual reconciliation.

engops_tim: Root cause summary: gateway retry path didn't propagate or honor client Idempotency-Key, and the metering pipeline accepted duplicate token events. Short-term mitigations: 
- Add dedupe at gateway based on request body + client_id for a 1s window
- Recommend SDKs/clients set Idempotency-Key on write ops and document retry semantics
- Add defensive dedupe in metering importer on upstream trace id or request hash

I'll open infra ticket INFRA-6524 to track.

customer_jane: We need the credit asap, this is causing CFO to flag the invoice.

maria_support: We'll issue a provisional credit now and follow up with full reconciliation details in the support case. Action: void ledger lt_9933 and create credit cr_2241 against inv_778a. Please confirm you want the credit applied to inv_778a.

customer_jane: Confirmed — please apply to inv_778a. Also we'll add Idempotency-Key in our client and tweak retry backoff. Could you add a note in the docs?

sre_alan: Short-term deployment note: we'll canary a gateway change tonight to return a deterministic 5xx -> 429 when backend has accepted but hasn't responded, to reduce blind client retries. Longer-term: require and enforce Idempotency-Key for write endpoints.

maria_support: Thanks everyone — I'll update the ticket with INFRA-6524 and the billing credit id cr_2241. Follow-up: we'll provide a postmortem once the fix is rolled. :thumbsup:
